description: This file contains functions for collecting and updating network interface statistics, including reading system stats, updating radio, access point, and endpoint statistics, and managing related data structures.

methods.name: s_addRadioStats
methods.description: Adds radio statistics from source to destination stats structure.

methods.name: s_addTxRxStats2Stats
methods.description: Adds interface TX/RX statistics to a stats structure, updating the latest update time.

methods.name: s_getLinuxLineStats
methods.description: Parses a line of system stats and updates corresponding data structures.

methods.name: s_getLinuxStats
methods.description: Reads system network interface stats from a file and updates radio, SSID, and endpoint stats.
